_comment: Registry of real third-party model files used by tests. The files themselves are NOT committed (testdata/models/ is gitignored); `python scripts/fetch-model-fixtures.py` downloads them at the pinned revision and verifies the sha256. `compiler` is the Ignition model id that must accept the config, or null when no compiler supports it yet (every compiler must then refuse it). Tests are generic: they iterate over this file, so adding a model means adding an entry here and nothing else.
